external_entities.name: sensor node
external_entities.description: A deployed sensor node installed at a customer site and publishing readings or polling firmware updates.
external_entities.source_excerpt: a few thousand sensor nodes installed on customer sites
external_entities.notes: The nodes are outside our physical control. Firmware signature verification is unknown: "I do not know whether the nodes check a signature on the image before installing it."

external_entities.name: field technician
external_entities.description: A technician who services sensor nodes over a local serial console.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Field technicians service nodes over a local serial console.

external_entities.name: fleet operator
external_entities.description: An operator who looks at telemetry dashboards from the corporate network.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our own fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery from the corporate network

processes.name: device gateway
processes.description: An MQTT broker running on GKE that receives readings from sensor nodes and forwards accepted readings.
processes.source_excerpt: the device gateway, which is an MQTT broker we run on GKE

processes.name: telemetry normalizer
processes.description: A Python consumer in the analytics network that picks up readings and writes them into the telemetry lake.
processes.source_excerpt: the telemetry normalizer, a Python consumer in our analytics network

processes.name: dashboard
processes.description: A dashboard used by fleet operators to view telemetry over BigQuery.
processes.source_excerpt: fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery

data_stores.name: device registry
data_stores.description: A Firestore registry used to check the node key and determine which customer the node belongs to.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a device registry (Firestore) to check the key and to find out which customer the node belongs to

data_stores.name: Pub/Sub
data_stores.description: A messaging service onto which accepted readings are forwarded and from which the telemetry normalizer picks them up.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Readings the gateway accepts are forwarded onto Pub/Sub

data_stores.name: telemetry lake
data_stores.description: A BigQuery data store containing site addresses and occupancy patterns, described as customer data.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The lake has site addresses and occupancy patterns in it, so it is customer data.

data_stores.name: firmware bucket
data_stores.description: A Cloud Storage bucket from which sensor nodes poll for firmware images.
data_stores.source_excerpt: nodes poll a Cloud Storage bucket for a new image
data_stores.notes: The bucket is public read. Node authentication to the bucket is not used.

data_flows.name: sensor node publishes readings to device gateway
data_flows.description: Sensor nodes publish readings to the device gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each node publishes readings over MQTT to the device gateway
data_flows.notes: The nodes authenticate to the broker with a pre-shared key. The key is per fleet, not per device, and has not been rotated since deployment.

data_flows.name: device gateway looks up device registry
data_flows.description: The gateway looks up the device registry to check the key and determine the customer's association.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway looks up the device in a device registry (Firestore)
data_flows.data_description: device key and customer association information

data_flows.name: device gateway forwards readings to Pub/Sub
data_flows.description: The gateway forwards accepted readings onto Pub/Sub.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Readings the gateway accepts are forwarded onto Pub/Sub

data_flows.name: telemetry normalizer picks up Pub/Sub readings
data_flows.description: The telemetry normalizer picks up readings from Pub/Sub.
data_flows.source_excerpt: picked up by the telemetry normalizer

data_flows.name: telemetry normalizer writes telemetry lake
data_flows.description: The telemetry normalizer writes readings into the telemetry lake.
data_flows.source_excerpt: which writes them into the telemetry lake in BigQuery
data_flows.data_description: sensor readings, including site addresses and occupancy patterns

data_flows.name: sensor node polls firmware bucket
data_flows.description: Sensor nodes poll the firmware bucket for a new image and install what they find.
data_flows.source_excerpt: nodes poll a Cloud Storage bucket for a new image and install what they find
data_flows.notes: The bucket is public read. It is unknown whether nodes check a signature on the image before installing it.

data_flows.name: field technician services sensor node
data_flows.description: A field technician services a sensor node over a local serial console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Field technicians service nodes over a local serial console.
data_flows.notes: Console authentication is unknown: "I don't know what authentication that console has, if any."

data_flows.name: fleet operator views dashboard
data_flows.description: Fleet operators look at dashboards from the corporate network.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our own fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery from the corporate network

data_flows.name: dashboard queries telemetry lake
data_flows.description: The dashboard accesses telemetry over BigQuery for fleet operators.

trust_boundaries.name: customer site
trust_boundaries.description: A customer-controlled site where sensor nodes are installed.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: sensor nodes installed on customer sites

trust_boundaries.name: internet
trust_boundaries.description: The public network from which sensor nodes dial in to the device gateway.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: expose to the internet because the nodes dial in from anywhere

trust_boundaries.name: analytics network
trust_boundaries.description: The network containing the telemetry normalizer and telemetry lake.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: the telemetry normalizer, a Python consumer in our analytics network

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network from which fleet operators access dashboards.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery from the corporate network

trust_boundaries.name: telemetry platform
trust_boundaries.description: The platform zone containing the named managed telemetry services whose network location is not otherwise stated.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Telemetry platform for our deployed sensor fleet.

assumptions.assumption: The telemetry lake contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the lake contains site addresses and occupancy patterns and calls this customer data.

assumptions.assumption: The dashboard presents a web interface.
assumptions.basis: The source describes fleet operators looking at dashboards; dashboards are treated as a user-facing web interface.
